run_boost_rebuilds_test: run the Boost.Build test script that verifies REBUILDS dependency propagation across targets
test_wait_for_bar: test the wait_for_bar helper function that waits for file timestamp changes before the next build run
test_boostbuild_tester: test the BoostBuild.Tester instance configured with debug flags -d+3 -d+12 -d+13 for rebuild verification
test_expect_addition: test the expect_addition method to verify new build artifacts like foo aux1 and aux2 are created
test_expect_touch: test the expect_touch method to verify all dependent targets are rebuilt when bar is touched
